title: [Main]- Lot-for-Lot accumulation splits supply into multiple requisition lines when Dampener Period and Safety Stock are enabled
summary: Fixed Lot-for-Lot accumulation in inventory planning to consolidate multiple requisition lines into one when both Dampener Period and Safety Stock are enabled.
key_points: Lot-for-Lot orders are no longer split unnecessarily when planned within a dampener period
Planning now allows new orders to grow within the lot accumulation period
Requires both Dampener Period and Safety Stock settings to be active
Multiple order lines are consolidated into a single requisition line
Improves supply planning efficiency and reduces fragmentation
